# Black Box - Autonomous AI Agent Observability & Causal Debugger

An observability and causal debugging platform for autonomous agents. Captures deterministic execution traces, isolates faulty upstream steps via ML classifiers, and allows counterfactual replays.

## Endpoints
- GET /health: Health status and database engine
- GET /runs/recent: Recent recorded traces
- GET /runs/{run_id}: Full execution graph and steps
- GET /runs/{run_id}/diagnosis: Model-ranked failure causes
- POST /runs: Start execution trace
- POST /runs/{run_id}/replay: Checkpointed counterfactual replay
- GET /runs/compare: Diff two traces
- GET /evaluation: Diagnostic accuracy metrics
